description: 인천교통공사_역사심도및높이 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 인천교통공사. 인천교통공사에서 운영중인 도시철도 인천1호선, 인천2호선,7호선 인천·부천구간의 2025년 6월30일 역사 심도 및 높이 현황입니다. 해당 데이터는 호선,역명,심도및높이(미터), 비고 항목으로 구성되어있습니다. 제공하는 데이터는 인천1호선 검단호수공원역에서 송도달빛축제공원역까지 33개역, 인천2호선 검단... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 인천교통공사. Its tags are 인천지하철, 역사 심도, 교량 높이, 인천1호선, 인천2호선. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
